sm.$description: A small square: an avatar in a dense list.

md.$description: A square beside a line of text: a thumbnail in a result row.

lg.$description: A square that carries a subject: a preview card.

xl.$description: A square that is the content: a profile header image.

target-min.$description: The smallest a control's height may compute to: the 24 CSS pixel target 2.5.8 asks for. Absolute on purpose, the one literal in a family that reads the space ramp: that rule is measured in CSS pixels and not in rhythm, so neither the density nor a brand's base may move it.
